config.title: Core Web Vitals (phone)
config.description: 75th percentile of each Core Web Vital for the page on phone over the last 28 days, colored by its rating.

config.title: Core Web Vitals (desktop)
config.description: 75th percentile of each Core Web Vital for the page on desktop over the last 28 days, colored by its rating.

config.title: Page vs whole site
config.description: Every metric for the page against every page on its site, on all devices over the last 28 days. Better and worse compare the 75th percentiles, where lower is better.

dataSourceConfig.sql:
SELECT
  page.metric,
  CASE WHEN page.metric = 'CLS' THEN printf('%.2f', page.p75) WHEN page.p75 >= 1000 THEN printf('%.2f s', page.p75 / 1000) ELSE printf('%d ms', CAST(round(page.p75) AS BIGINT)) END AS pageP75,
  CASE WHEN site.metric = 'CLS' THEN printf('%.2f', site.p75) WHEN site.p75 >= 1000 THEN printf('%.2f s', site.p75 / 1000) ELSE printf('%d ms', CAST(round(site.p75) AS BIGINT)) END AS siteP75,
  CASE page.rating WHEN 'success' THEN 'Good' WHEN 'warning' THEN 'Needs improvement' ELSE 'Poor' END AS pageRating,
  CASE site.rating WHEN 'success' THEN 'Good' WHEN 'warning' THEN 'Needs improvement' ELSE 'Poor' END AS siteRating,
  CASE
    WHEN round(page.p75, 2) < round(site.p75, 2) THEN 'Better'
    WHEN round(page.p75, 2) > round(site.p75, 2) THEN 'Worse'
    ELSE 'Same'
  END AS comparison
FROM page
JOIN site ON page.metric = site.metric
ORDER BY CASE page.metric WHEN 'LCP' THEN 1 WHEN 'INP' THEN 2 WHEN 'CLS' THEN 3 WHEN 'FCP' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

config.title: Distribution (phone)
config.description: Share of visits to the page on phone that had a good, needs improvement or poor experience of each metric over the last 28 days.

dataSourceConfig.sql:
SELECT metric, bucket, share
FROM (
  SELECT metric, CASE metric WHEN 'LCP' THEN 1 WHEN 'INP' THEN 2 WHEN 'CLS' THEN 3 WHEN 'FCP' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS metricOrder, 1 AS bucketOrder, 'Good' AS bucket, CAST(good AS DOUBLE) AS share FROM vitals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT metric, CASE metric WHEN 'LCP' THEN 1 WHEN 'INP' THEN 2 WHEN 'CLS' THEN 3 WHEN 'FCP' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS metricOrder, 2 AS bucketOrder, 'Needs improvement' AS bucket, CAST(needsImprovement AS DOUBLE) AS share FROM vitals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT metric, CASE metric WHEN 'LCP' THEN 1 WHEN 'INP' THEN 2 WHEN 'CLS' THEN 3 WHEN 'FCP' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS metricOrder, 3 AS bucketOrder, 'Poor' AS bucket, CAST(poor AS DOUBLE) AS share FROM vitals
)
ORDER BY metricOrder, bucketOrder

config.title: Distribution (desktop)
config.description: Share of visits to the page on desktop that had a good, needs improvement or poor experience of each metric over the last 28 days.

dataSourceConfig.sql:
SELECT metric, bucket, share
FROM (
  SELECT metric, CASE metric WHEN 'LCP' THEN 1 WHEN 'INP' THEN 2 WHEN 'CLS' THEN 3 WHEN 'FCP' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS metricOrder, 1 AS bucketOrder, 'Good' AS bucket, CAST(good AS DOUBLE) AS share FROM vitals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT metric, CASE metric WHEN 'LCP' THEN 1 WHEN 'INP' THEN 2 WHEN 'CLS' THEN 3 WHEN 'FCP' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS metricOrder, 2 AS bucketOrder, 'Needs improvement' AS bucket, CAST(needsImprovement AS DOUBLE) AS share FROM vitals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT metric, CASE metric WHEN 'LCP' THEN 1 WHEN 'INP' THEN 2 WHEN 'CLS' THEN 3 WHEN 'FCP' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS metricOrder, 3 AS bucketOrder, 'Poor' AS bucket, CAST(poor AS DOUBLE) AS share FROM vitals
)
ORDER BY metricOrder, bucketOrder

config.title: LCP breakdown
config.description: The 75th percentile of each part of an image LCP for the page on all devices over the last 28 days, in load order. Each part is its own 75th percentile, so they do not add up to the LCP.

config.title: LCP element
config.description: Whether the largest element on screen was an image or text, as a share of visits to the page over the last 28 days.

config.title: LCP trend
config.description: Largest Contentful Paint at the 75th percentile for the page against its whole site on phone. Each point is the 28 days ending that week. The lines mark the good and poor thresholds.

dataSourceConfig.sql:
SELECT periodEnd, 'Page' AS series, p75 FROM page WHERE metric = 'LCP'
UNION ALL
SELECT periodEnd, 'Whole site' AS series, p75 FROM site WHERE metric = 'LCP'
ORDER BY periodEnd, series
